purpose: Byte-identical copies of the Concrete Gospel sources needed to rebuild the approved V2 drum/bass backing. Nothing here is edited; backing.ts imports them and verifies the rebuild against V2's delivered hashes.

source.commitSubject: Concrete Gospel V2: drum surgery (kick, snare, pocket, 808 duck)
source.base: 917f4439f85a9f7bfba1c336c1f76090a24b49e3 (main, the same base as this branch)

files.role: V1 composition (hook, 808 notes, choir, bell, form). V2 imports it unchanged.
V2 composition: the approved kick/snare layering, pocket, hats, 808 duck and mix.
V2's delivered hashes (master WAV, MP3, stems, engine stem WAVs): the reference the rebuild is checked against.

verification: node experiments/cathedral-experiment-001/backing.ts rebuilds V2 with the same commands as V2's build.ts `full` and requires the master WAV and all 12 engine stem WAVs to match these hashes bit for bit (Linux, Node 22.23.5, FFmpeg 6.1.1-3ubuntu5).
